confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary widely by season and property; July is monsoon low season, so accommodation may be at the lower end. Cocktail and wine were set at roughly twice the beer price, as local price relationships are weakly known. Taxes and service charges are assumed to be included in restaurant prices. The FX value 0.6955 was read from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as shown in search results; I did not open the page or the F11.1 table directly, and a third-party figure of 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 is unverified, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Nepali tourist cities such as Pokhara and the Thamel/Lazimpat visitor areas of Kathmandu, benchmarked against budget-to-midrange South Asian tourist destinations. Nepal's rupee is pegged to the Indian rupee, which informed the general price level. No single comparable city was used.
